text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 32

An all-male panel is not evidence of discrimination on its own — it's common in senior finance and often reflects who's already in post. Treated as your headline argument, it looks weak and easily rebutted.

It does matter as context, alongside stronger facts: your qualifications exceed the stated ones for a modelling role, and they've ignored a reasonable request for written reasons for two weeks.

So lead with the substance. Send a firm follow-up requesting the panel's scoring criteria, your scores, and the reasons. Mention composition only as one factor among several, if at all.

If their answer is vague or the criteria appear invented after the fact, that's when raising it directly becomes worthwhile — ideally with employment-law advice.
